en: Black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard with several photographs of a seaside resort town. Images include a grand curved arcade with columns and cars parked in front, tennis courts, manicured gardens with palm trees, a large casino-like building, a thermal baths and hotel complex, a coastal panorama with boats/rowing on the water, and extensive park grounds. The right side has the address area labeled 'CARTA POSTAL' with a Portuguese postal stamp. A caption panel reads 'ESTORIL — COSTA DO SOL' and other small captions label each vignette.
